import { bootSequence } from './src/boot-loader.js'; const startBoot = () => { console.log('[Orchestrator] Starting Boot Sequence...'); bootSequence().catch(err => console.error('[Orchestrator] Boot Sequence Failed:', err)); }; if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', startBoot, { once: true }); else startBoot();
